Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

occasion noun

a particular time when something happens

also on this occasion, on that occasion, on one occasion, on another occasion, on the same occasion, for the occasion, as the occasion allows, to suit the occasion, as time allows, at one time … at another

classical

Cic. Att. 2.12.1: ūnō tempore
Traupman 88: for the occasion, in tempus

tempus, temporis n.

noun, third declension

the time, the occasion

On this or that occasion is hōc tempore, eō tempore; on the same occasion, at once, ūnō tempore; for the occasion, in tempus (see temporary, moment).

Other words

  • aliās — on another occasion, another time

    adverb · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 7.6.2: plūra scrībēmus aliās; Traupman 88: at another time, aliās; Traupman 394

    Doubled, it is “on one occasion … on another” (aliās … aliās, Traupman 88).

  • quōdam diē — on one occasion, one day

    phrase · also used · classical · Plin. NH 15.74: adtulit quōdam diē; Traupman 88: once (on a certain occasion), quōdam diē

  • prō tempore — as the occasion allows, to suit the occasion

    also used · classical · Sall. Jug. 49.6: pauca prō tempore mīlitēs hortātus (Lewis & Short s.v. hortor); Traupman 109 (for “for the time being”)

    Sallust’s general says a few words, as much as time allowed. Not “for the time being” (see temporary).

  • occāsiō, occāsiōnis f. — an opportunity, the right moment

    noun, third declension · avoid · classical

    Not this sense: occāsiō is the chance or the right moment to do something, not simply a time when something happens (see opportunity).

Examples

  • sed plūra scrībēmus aliās

    but I’ll write more on another occasionCic. Fam. 7.6.2

  • adtulit quōdam diē in cūriam praecocem ex eā prōvinciā fīcum

    on one occasion he brought into the senate house an early fig from that provincePlin. NH 15.74

  • ō suāvīs epistulās tuās ūnō tempore mihi datās duās!

    what lovely letters of yours, two of them handed to me on the same occasion!Cic. Att. 2.12.1

  • aliās … aliās

    at one time … at anotherTraupman 394

See also moment, opportunity, reason, temporary.
